ref_interface.inventory_shape: native filename -> sha256; snapshot filename -> sha256

repaired_interface.complete_arm_association: config_sha256 equals exact repaired config binding
repaired_interface.inventory_shape: native filename -> {bytes, sha256}; pre_extraction_snapshot filename -> {bytes, sha256}

exact_missing_link: Neither arm COMPLETE nor pair COMPLETE contains the artifact_inventory.json SHA256. Pair COMPLETE binds only each arm COMPLETE hash. Therefore pair COMPLETE alone does not cryptographically identify the exact saved arrays consumed downstream.
required_consumer_checks: require the execution_states key set to equal exactly REF384_repeat and repaired_B384
require exact resolved COMPLETE paths, regular non-symlink files, and matching complete_sha256
validate REF arm field and repaired config_sha256 association
derive curated paths from producer contract/config, never basename or caller-selected suffix
require exact resolved inventory paths inside the corresponding arm namespace
bind both inventory receipt SHA256 values in the reviewed Phase3 request/tokens
recompute inventory entries against every consumed file and reject missing, extra-role, swapped, escaped, symlinked, or hash/size-mismatched inputs
strict_transitive_option: If request/token binding of deterministic inventory receipts is not accepted as sufficient, the producer must be revised so each arm COMPLETE directly contains artifact_inventory_sha256; the current producer has no such edge.
